content: Restate: durable execution via journaling -- every ctx.run() call and its result is journaled; crash/failure replays the journal, skipping completed steps, retrying failed ones automatically. Virtual Objects: keyed stateful services with single-writer-per-key consistency (built-in KV store), state updates recorded alongside execution steps. Workflows are a specialized Virtual Object with a run handler guaranteed exactly-once per workflow instance ID. Three durable service types: Basic Services (stateless), Virtual Objects (stateful/concurrent), Workflows (multi-step orchestration) -- requires a Restate server/runtime, unlike DBOS/entflow's library-only model.
